name: The Natural History Room
desc: One double bed among antiques and cabinets of nature collections — the room for the person who reads the labels.

name: The Rose Room
desc: Two twin beds, a complete Art Deco furniture set, and roses worked through every detail of the décor.

name: The Chinese Wedding Room
desc: A 1940s waterfall double, a child's bed, and an Oriental rug — the warmest room in the house in October.
